messages.text:
"GAME DEVELOPMENT PROMPT — ADITYA: OPERATION DHARMA RAKSHAK

Create a complete, realistic-looking 2D side-scrolling military commando action game for Android.

1. Game identity

- Title: ADITYA: OPERATION DHARMA RAKSHAK
- Tagline: ONE SOLDIER. ONE NATION. ONE MISSION.
- Genre: Military action, stealth, commando shooter.
- Camera: 2D side-scrolling.
- Platform: Android mobile.
- Engine: HTML5, CSS and JavaScript.
- Rendering: HTML5 Canvas.
- Mode: Single-player offline.
- Design inspiration: Project IGI 2: Covert Strike.

2. Main hero

ADITYA — an elite Indian commando from Jharkhand.

- Olive-green military uniform.
- Indian flag patch.
- Tactical vest, boots and sunglasses.
- Rifle-holding character sprite.
- Running, walking, jumping, crouching, shooting and reloading animations.

3. Special IGI-inspired health indicator

This is a very important feature. Reproduce the visual concept from my reference image.

Display a full-body commando silhouette holding a rifle inside a dark tactical grid panel.

Health colours:

- 100–76%: Bright neon green (#00FF00).
- 75–51%: Green-yellow.
- 50–26%: Orange.
- 25–1%: Dark red.
- 0%: Completely dark silhouette.

Requirements:

- The silhouette must represent Aditya.
- The entire soldier, including helmet, rifle, legs and boots, must be visible.
- Health colour must change dynamically as Aditya receives damage.
- Add a subtle neon glow.
- Add a digital grid background.
- Display HP: 100/100.
- Use ONE health system only.
- Do not add a separate armour bar.
- The health indicator must update during gameplay.

4. Gameplay HUD

- Soldier silhouette health indicator at top-left.
- Single HP bar.
- Weapon image and ammunition counter at top-right.
- Enemy radar/minimap.
- Mission objective panel.
- Pause button.
- Mobile joystick.
- Aim and fire buttons.
- Jump, crouch, reload and grenade controls.

5. Weapons

- Assault rifle.
- Pistol.
- Sniper rifle.
- Shotgun.
- Grenades.

Each weapon must have working shooting, ammunition and reload mechanics.

6. Twelve Jharkhand missions

1. Operation Sal Forest — Saranda.
2. Bokaro Steel Shadow — Bokaro.
3. Black Diamond — Dhanbad.
4. Ranchi Alert — Ranchi.
5. Mission Netarhat — Netarhat.
6. Hilltop Betrayal — Parasnath Hills.
7. Iron City — Jamshedpur.
8. Waterfall Ambush — Hundru Falls.
9. The Hazaribagh Files — Hazaribagh.
10. Operation Homeland — Chaibasa.
11. The Hidden Fortress — fictional Jharkhand mountain base.
12. Operation Dharma Rakshak — final battle against Zafar Qureshi.

All terrorist incidents and enemy bases are fictional.

7. Main characters

- Aditya — playable commando.
- Arti — intelligence officer and mission guide.
- Kishore — Aditya's father and mission strategist.
- Zafar Qureshi — fictional terrorist organisation leader.
- Rashid Khan — field commander.
- Imran Shah — sniper.
- Farooq Malik — security commander.
- Samiullah — field captain.
- Abdul Rahman — intelligence chief.

8. Enemy organisation

AL-ZULFIQAR NETWORK — a fictional extremist terrorist organisation.

Create unique fictional enemy character designs, tactical uniforms, patrols, guards, commanders and boss encounters. Do not portray any real religious community as an enemy.

9. Environments

Create realistic 2D environments:

- Dense Jharkhand forests.
- Military camps.
- Industrial factories.
- Coal mines.
- Mountain installations.
- Watchtowers.
- Underground bunkers.
- Military vehicles.
- Enemy headquarters.

10. Gameplay systems

- Enemy AI and patrols.
- Stealth and combat.
- Health damage and medkits.
- Ammunition and reload.
- Weapon switching.
- Explosions and muzzle flashes.
- Mission objectives.
- Checkpoints.
- Rescue operations.
- Boss battles.
- Mission completion screen.
- Three-star mission ratings.
- Easy, Normal and Hard difficulty.

11. Graphics and performance

- Realistic 2D military graphics.
- Smooth character animations.
- Professional tactical HUD.
- Cinematic mission introductions.
- Responsive Android touch controls.
- Landscape fullsc

---
This is a build request. Build a complete, playable game now (or apply the requested change to the existing game). Do not ask clarifying questions; make reasonable assumptions and note them briefly when you finish.

Screenshots for your own checks: save small JPEGs (a .jpg path, viewport at most 1280px wide) and read only the latest one; older images are dropped from context. Read a full-size PNG only when fine detail matters.
"
